segments.text: How to properly wash your hands in food service.
Turn on the faucet with warm water and wet your hands.
With either a soap dispenser or a bar of soap, apply some to your hands.
Scrub your entire hands up to just above your wrists for 20 seconds.
Rinse your hands in warm water to wash off all the soap.
Use a hand drying station or paper towel to dry your hands.
Use a piece of paper towel to turn off the faucet.
